c001c11160157a10.job_title: Senior Manager - Financial Analysis & Modeling - 50011703 (Sports BU-DFA-SBU207)
c001c11160157a10.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced Senior Manager - Financial Analysis & Modeling to lead the development, maintenance, and governance of financial models across a portfolio of strategic development projects. The role will be responsible for creating robust financial models, driving investment analysis, supporting business planning, evaluating strategic opportunities, and providing decision-making insights to senior leadership. This position requires a highly analytical professional with deep expertise in financial modeling, valuation, feasibility assessment, scenario planning, and portfolio performance analysis. Key Responsibilities: Develop and maintain complex financial models, including DCF, project finance, and scenario analysis models. Lead project feasibility studies and evaluate investment opportunities. Analyze project and portfolio performance, including IRR, NPV, ROE, cash flow, and profitability metrics. Prepare business plans, forecasts, and financial recommendations for management and investment committees. Conduct sensitivity and what-if analyses to support strategic decision-making. Challenge commercial and financial assumptions across development projects. Prepare executive reports, investment memos, and presentations for senior stakeholders. Drive continuous improvement in financial modeling, reporting, and analytical processes. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in financial analysis, financial modeling, investment analysis, or project finance. Strong experience building and maintaining complex financial models. Advanced Excel financial modeling skills. Experience with DCF valuation, feasibility studies, forecasting, and business planning. Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is preferred.

Design the technical object structure (functional locations and equipment) Configure maintenance plans, notifications and preventive/corrective maintenance orders Set up maintenance cost settlement with CO and spare parts procurement with MM Support PM master data migration, testing, training and go-live Requirements: 4+ years SAP PM/EAM experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud exposure Valid SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification (Asset Management area) Strong knowledge of preventive maintenance strategies Integration knowledge with MM and FI/CO

c01be556edaab996.description: About the Role Boehringer Ingelheim is seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive support to the General Manager and the Leadership Team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is designed for an individual who excels in a dynamic environment and demonstrates professionalism in all interactions. Role Overview The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation of executive functions. This involves managing administrative tasks, coordinating key activities, and facilitating effective communication within the leadership structure. The ideal candidate will be adept at multitasking and maintaining a high level of organizational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Provide personal assistance to the General Manager. Offer support to the Leadership Team as required. Coordinate meetings, including scheduling and logistics. Arrange travel for the General Manager and Leadership Team. Manage day-to-day executive support tasks. Plan, document, and follow up on management meetings. Organize team activities to foster collaboration. Coach team members to ensure smooth execution across business functions. Lead and support internal events and cross-functional initiatives. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in an executive support role, demonstrating a proven ability to manage complex administrative tasks and support senior leadership effectively. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic corporate environment, requiring adaptability and a proactive approach to support the General Manager and Leadership Team. c06a359bf4752aad.description: About PROMISE PROMISE is a corporate services firm that assists companies in establishing and operating within Saudi Arabia. The firm provides support across market entry, company formation, licensing, HR compliance, immigration, payroll, bookkeeping, and advisory services. PROMISE aims to streamline operations and prevent regulatory delays by integrating company formation, HR, immigration, and payroll processes across national platforms. The mission of PROMISE is to facilitate global business operations within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Role Overview PROMISE is seeking a Business Setup Consultant to manage company formation and business setup processes for local and foreign clients in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience. The consultant will serve as the primary point of contact, overseeing the entire incorporation lifecycle from MISA/commercial registration through licensing and post-incorporation. This involves acting as a liaison between clients, internal teams, and government authorities to ensure timely and compliant case completion. Key Responsibilities Manage the full company setup process for local and foreign clients, from entity selection to license issuance. Handle commercial registration (CR) issuance, amendments, renewals, and cancellations. Support foreign investment licensing through the Ministry of Investment (MISA) and related approvals. Prepare, review, and submit incorporation documents, including Articles of Association, resolutions, powers of attorney, and supporting files. Advise clients on entity types, licensing options, costs, timelines, and regulatory requirements. Keep clients updated on status and next steps, proactively resolving missing documents and delays. Coordinate with government authorities such as the Ministry of Commerce / Saudi Business Center, MISA, chambers of commerce, municipalities (Balady), and sector regulators. Operate relevant government platforms (*, Saudi Business Center, MISA, Qiwa, Muqeem, GOSI, ZATCA, Balady, National Address / SPL, MHRSD). Coordinate ZATCA/tax registration, GOSI registration, national address registration, bank account opening, visa quota / Nitaqat setup, and document attestation. Set up corporate files and manage subsequent amendments and ownership changes. Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and compliant to minimize rejected applications. Maintain organized records and keep CRM/trackers current. Prepare periodic reports on case progress, pending items, and operational challenges. Safeguard the confidentiality of all client information. Key Services Supported Company formation, business setup, and commercial registration (issuance and renewal). Investment (MISA) license applications and foreign-ownership setup. Articles of association and corporate document coordination. Chamber of commerce registration and municipal/sector-specific licenses. Tax/ZATCA and GOSI registration coordination. National address registration and bank-account coordination. Corporate amendments, ownership changes, license renewals, and cancellations. Post-incorporation corporate support and government-platform registrations. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in business setup, corporate services, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex incorporation lifecycles. Proficiency in coordinating with government authorities and operating relevant platforms. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and compliance. Application Process Candidates interested in this Business Setup Consultant position at PROMISE in Riyadh are encouraged to apply. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

c09b18d21916b716.job_title: Design & Project Manager Real Estate Development
c09b18d21916b716.description: About the Role The Real Estate Business Development Section Head supports the Real Estate Business Development Manager at Saudi Railway Company in identifying and pursuing real estate opportunities. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing specific projects, conducting market and financial analysis, and maintaining relationships with stakeholders to ensure successful business and project outcomes. Key Responsibilities Manage real estate projects from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and delivery within established timelines and budgets. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate project progress and resolve issues. Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive dynamics within the real estate sector. Prepare reports and presentations on market conditions and project feasibility. Build and maintain relationships with investors, developers, and government entities to support project objectives. Represent Saudi Railway Company at industry events, meetings, and negotiations to advance business development goals. Assist in the development of financial models and business cases for real estate projects. Monitor project financial performance and report on key metrics to the Real Estate Business Development Manager. Ensure all real estate activities comply with legal and regulatory requirements. Identify potential risks in real estate projects and assist in developing mitigation strategies. Support the review and negotiation of contracts with external partners. Ensure proper documentation and compliance requirements are met for all real estate transactions. Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of processes and practices within the real estate department. Implement best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in business development activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess between 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in real estate business development or a related field. The position requires a strong understanding of real estate market dynamics, financial analysis, and project management principles. Required Skills Proficiency in market research and financial analysis. Strong project management capabilities. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with diverse stakeholders. Knowledge of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to real estate. Risk identification and mitigation planning. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Saudi Railway Company. The role involves working closely with internal teams and external partners to achieve real estate business development objectives. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. The salary for this position is not disclosed.

c0b1a1eb2a76ce6e.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Procurement Specialist to join its team in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah cities. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves supporting procurement activities across ALJ-Motors and other sister companies. Role Overview The Procurement Specialist will assist the Head of CPD in procurement, negotiation, and supply chain operations. This position is responsible for managing procurements, deliverables, and correspondence, ensuring the end-to-end procurement process is executed efficiently and in compliance with company policies. Key Responsibilities Perform the procurement process from initiation to completion. Review, update, and control all procurement activities. Manage procurement documents, including receiving, sending, archiving, uploading, and attaching as required. Ensure continuous follow-up with all stakeholders to complete the procurement lifecycle. Support procurement activities for materials, goods, and/or services in accordance with CPD policy & SOPs. Negotiate with suppliers and vendors to secure advantageous terms and engage reliable partners. Prepare supporting reports and provide guidance to ALJ associates regarding inquiries. Maintain procurement files and databases, analyze contents, clauses, figures, and required reports. Coordinate with Finance and end-users to close and settle Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt (GR-IR) transactions. Apply appropriate risk management and mitigate risks during all stages of procurement. Coordinate with other Corporate Shared Services Division (CSS) staff to fulfill corporate policy requirements. Contribute to achieving overall procurement goals and objectives with a focus on continuous improvement. Assist in settling disputes between ALJ and suppliers, communicating with legal departments, and providing relevant information. Guide ALJ associates on initiating procurement actions within APPIAN, SAP, or other systems. Receive and review vendor registration documents to ensure qualification as per policy. Manage and maintain the vendor database in BP-SAP. Update Business Partner (BP) Master data in SAP to ensure compliance with laws and company policies. Prepare and follow up on Purchase Requisitions (PR), Purchase Orders (PO), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), Requests for Proposal (RFP), Requests for Approval (RFA), Service Agreement Letters (SAL), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA), and other agreements. Confirm delivery of goods and services, manage invoice handover, submit for payments, and follow up. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in procurement or a related field. Demonstrated ability to perform end-to-end procurement processes. Experience in negotiating with suppliers and managing vendor relationships. Proficiency in maintaining procurement files and databases. Familiarity with systems such as APPIAN and SAP is preferred. Impact and Authority This role directly impacts the timely delivery of orders and the implementation of comprehensive supplier performance management. The Procurement Specialist has the authority to approve or decline vendor proposals in alignment with ALJ policies and business requirements, and plays a crucial supportive role in reducing administrative workload.

c06f1110b87abe0f.description: About Asteri Beauty Asteri Beauty (B Corp™) is a modern, high-performance beauty brand based in Saudi Arabia. The brand focuses on clean, long-wearing formulas with rich color payoff and skin-loving ingredients, designed for the desert climate. As the company expands across the GCC and internationally, it seeks professionals to contribute to its growth. The Role: Key Account Manager/Beauty Asteri Beauty is seeking a Key Account Manager/Beauty with over 10 years of experience for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for leading and executing commercial and strategic distribution operations across key retail accounts in the GCC region, including major accounts such as Ulta Beauty, Travel Retail (Duty Free / Airport Outlets), and regional key accounts. The position is pivotal in growing brand visibility, driving revenue across physical and omnichannel wholesale doors, building strong key-partner relationships, and executing trade marketing and inventory strategies. Key Responsibilities Formulate and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) for major retail partners, establishing sales targets, promotional calendars, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Drive sell-in and sell-through strategies across accounts, monitoring weekly and monthly sales data to identify growth opportunities. Lead negotiations for space and shelf-location, new product listings, end-cap placements, and travel-exclusive product offerings. Oversee the execution of in-store activations, promotional offers, Gift with Purchase (GWP) campaigns, and travel retail display activations. Partner with Marketing & Brand Communication on campaign launches, visual merchandising standards, promotional calendars, and co-branded retail activation plans. Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics & Operations on demand forecasting, order processing, stock allocation, and shipment timelines. Collaborate with Finance & Commercial Teams on trade spend budgets, margin analysis, credit terms, promotional spend ROI, and annual joint business planning. Work with Retail Operations & Education/Training to ensure brand standards, customer experience levels, and product education across partner doors. Serve as the main point of contact for Retail Buyers & Category Managers, managing range planning, space negotiation, assortment expansion, and promotional execution. Ensure smooth stock replenishment, logistics compliance, and adherence to retail distribution guidelines with retail partners' Supply Chain & Merchandising Teams. Manage relationships with concessionaires and airport operators across the GCC region to maximize duty-free door performance. Candidate Profile and Requirements Over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of retail margins, sell-out mechanics, inventory turn rates, and trade marketing budgets. High proficiency in data analysis, demand planning inputs, and retail sales reporting (Excel/PowerBI). Strategic thinker with strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills. Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and proactive mindset. Willingness to travel across the GCC (*, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) and international travel retail hubs as required.

c017ecd0b22da47d.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading all mechanical engineering activities related to the restoration of facility buildings and hangars. The successful candidate will ensure that critical mechanical systems are restored, tested, and commissioned according to approved designs, applicable codes, and company standards. Key Responsibilities The Mechanical Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the restoration of HVAC, compressed air, generator mechanical systems, and door mechanisms. This includes a range of tasks from initial assessment to final commissioning and documentation. Specific Duties Conduct site condition assessments for HVAC, compressed air, and other mechanical systems. Coordinate equipment lead times and delivery schedules with manufacturers and suppliers. Develop mechanical technical input for scopes of work, tender documents, and bills of quantities. Perform technical evaluations of bidder and contractor proposals. Review and approve manufacturer submittals, shop drawings, and equipment selections. Supervise installation, testing, adjusting and balancing, and commissioning activities. Monitor contractor performance, quality, and compliance with the approved scope and schedule. Verify and approve as-built drawings, test reports, and operation and maintenance manuals. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on on-site activities related to facility and hangar restoration projects. Application Process Candidates interested in this Mechanical Engineer position are encouraged to apply.

c01ef4af5672b29d.description: About KBR, Inc. KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovation and collaboration, committed to improving the world responsibly and safely. The organization values a diverse workforce and leverages creativity and resourcefulness to deliver expertise. The Role: Rotating Technician II KBR is seeking a Rotating Technician II to join their team in Rabigh or Makkah, Makkah region. This full-time position involves maintaining rotating equipment in optimal condition, performing installations, and executing maintenance and repair tasks on rotating equipment and mechanical systems according to established standards. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Allocate maintenance activities to technicians and assemble the necessary team. Supervise ongoing jobs and provide progress updates to the Foreman. Organize manpower resources, equipment, and material availability for tasks. Arrange necessary work permits prior to commencing work. Provide technical advice to technicians regarding the proper use of tools and equipment. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance Planning, and Technical departments to execute and complete jobs efficiently. Ensure accurate SAP data input, history, and actual hours are maintained. Attend daily and weekly maintenance progress meetings. Safety and Compliance Maintain strict compliance with SATORP standards and guidelines. Ensure adherence to safe work practices, hazardous work regulations, and PPE usage according to SATORP standards. Encourage the reporting of near misses, unsafe conditions, and acts. Participate in Safety audits. Attend scheduled Safety and Technical training sessions. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in maintaining rotating equipment and mechanical systems.

c06a915cc6391b7b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث اسطول الريان للخدمات اللوجستية عن أخصائي جمركي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحليل البضائع والمنتجات لتحديد تصنيفها الجمركي بدقة، مع ضمان الامتثال للأنظمة واللوائح الجمركية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى أخصائي الجمارك مسؤولية تبنيد وترجمة البضائع والمنتجات، وتحديد بنودها وتصنيفها الجمركي وفقاً للنظام المنسق (HS Code) والتعرفة الجمركية المعتمدة. يشمل ذلك مراجعة المستندات التجارية والفنية وترجمتها عند الحاجة، والتأكد من صحة البيانات والتصنيفات لتجنب أي مخالفات أو تأخير في الشحنات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد وتبنيد الأصناف والبضائع وفق رموز النظام المنسق (HS Code). مراجعة وتحليل الفواتير التجارية وقوائم التعبئة وشهادات المنشأ. ترجمة المستندات والمواصفات الفنية من العربية إلى الإنجليزية والعكس. دراسة طبيعة المنتجات ومكوناتها واستخداماتها لتحديد البند الجمركي الصحيح. مراجعة التعرفة الجمركية واللوائح والاشتراطات المتعلقة بالاستيراد والتصدير. التأكد من صحة التصنيف الجمركي وتجنب الأخطاء التي قد تؤدي إلى غرامات أو تأخير الشحنات. التنسيق مع المخلصين الجمركيين وشركات الشحن والجهات ذات العلاقة. متابعة التحديثات على بنود التعرفة الجمركية والأنظمة الجمركية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التخليص الجمركي أو التصنيف الجمركي. معرفة قوية بالنظام المنسق (HS Code) والتعرفة الجمركية. القدرة على تحليل المستندات التجارية والفنية بدقة. مهارات ترجمة ممتازة من العربية إلى الإنجليزية والعكس. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الأخصائي الجمركي ضمن فريق متخصص في الخدمات اللوجستية، ويكون مسؤولاً عن ضمان الامتثال الجمركي لجميع الشحنات. التقديم للوظيفة إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة ولديك الشغف بالعمل في مجال الخدمات اللوجستية والتخليص الجمركي، ندعوك للتقديم لهذه الفرصة في اسطول الريان للخدمات اللوجستية.

c07ee10cac057c56.description: About the Role Wipro is seeking a GRC Consulting professional to join their team in Yanbu, Madina. This full-time role focuses on ensuring adherence to cybersecurity regulatory frameworks by analyzing attack patterns, developing incident response plans, and implementing disaster recovery measures. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to analyze attack patterns, develop comprehensive incident response plans, ensure audit readiness, and implement effective disaster recovery measures. This is crucial for maintaining adherence to established cybersecurity regulatory frameworks and standards. Key Responsibilities Analyze attack trends and correlate logs across various systems to identify advanced threats and enhance monitoring processes for faster detection, ensuring compliance with security frameworks. Perform root cause analysis, create detailed incident response plans, and implement disaster recovery measures to minimize business disruption. Undertake forensic analysis using advanced analytics tools and implement mitigation measures to align with compliance requirements. Liaise with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and auditors to ensure compliance with security frameworks. Maintain accurate audit documentation and implement processes that support continuous audit readiness and compliance. Assist in creating and delivering cybersecurity awareness sessions, including guidance on phishing and malicious emails. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in GRC consulting or a related cybersecurity field. Demonstrated ability to analyze attack patterns and develop robust incident response plans. Experience with implementing disaster recovery measures and ensuring audit readiness. Familiarity with cybersecurity regulatory frameworks and compliance standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Yanbu, Madina. The role involves coordination with various internal and external stakeholders to achieve cybersecurity objectives. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

c045a880fb387d78.description: Tamara Builders Program Cohorts: January yearly | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build About us Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions. Machine Learning: Turn data into intelligent solutions. You'll explore machine learning models and algorithms that uncover patterns, predict outcomes, and power smarter products and experiences. Data Engineering: Build the foundations behind millions of data points. You'll work on pipelines, platforms, and infrastructure that transform raw data into reliable, accessible insights. Data Science: Turn complex data into meaningful discoveries. You'll use statistics, experimentation, and advanced analytical techniques to solve problems, uncover opportunities, and shape business decisions. What We Look For in a Builder Experience A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering or similar, depending on your area of interest) Up to 2 years of experience, including prior internships or co-ops Passionate about continuous iteration and bringing a creative mindset to solving problems, no matter the function. Some exposure to your area of interest, through coursework, internships, or projects, is a plus, but potential matters more than a perfect CV Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a bias toward data-driven decisions Excellent communication skills, written and verbal Organizational skills: able to prioritize, multi-task, and work independently Comfortable working with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go Attributes Curious, driven, and genuinely excited to build A self-starter who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told Resilient and adaptable: you find a way through, not around, a challenge A collaborative team player who leads with empathy and respect Goal-oriented, with high personal standards and the energy to match them Why Tamara? Our teams are made up of innovators, problem-solvers, and learners. We thrive on curiosity and collaboration. If this sounds like you: curious, driven, and ready to build, we'd love to meet you. Apply now and join the next generation of Builders. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. To learn more about how we protect your privacy, please visit our Candidate Privacy Notice . Note: the functions listed above aren't an exhaustive list. If you're interested in an area we haven't mentioned here, tell us on your application; we still want to hear from you.

c05de00242d17359.description: About the Role The University of Prince Mugrin is seeking a Quality and Accreditation Specialist to join its team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring that the university's programs, processes, and services meet both internal and external quality standards. The specialist will lead and coordinate accreditation processes, quality assurance initiatives, and continuous improvement activities, collaborating with academic and administrative departments to implement best practices and maintain compliance. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate accreditation efforts for national and international accrediting bodies. Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation required for accreditation processes. Collaborate with university departments to gather and analyze data for accreditation reports, ensuring continuous compliance with standards. Develop quality auditing systems, procedures, and models; participate in developing periodic and annual audit plans; and implement quality control processes. Prepare and develop questionnaires to measure customer satisfaction with provided services and processes, documenting and analyzing recommendations for improvement. Recommend and implement improvements to enhance the quality of academic programs and administrative processes. Assist in the development, review, and feedback process for university policies, procedures, and guidelines to ensure they meet quality and accreditation standards. Prepare specialized documents and reports related to specifications and standards, providing recommendations and maintaining them on the corresponding database. Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and accrediting bodies. Maintain accurate records of accreditation processes, assessments, and quality assurance activities. Provide training and guidance to faculty and staff on accreditation standards, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement methodologies. Facilitate workshops and seminars to promote a quality culture across the university. Identify and initiate continuous improvement activities within academic and operational areas, monitoring their implementation and effectiveness. Collaborate with academic departments, administrative units, and external accrediting bodies to ensure alignment with quality standards. Serve as the primary point of contact for accreditation inquiries and communications. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and accreditation processes, preferably within an educational institution. Application Process Interested applicants are invited to apply online. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview by the screening committee.

c06362facebc884d.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن شركة green fitness عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى موظف مبيعات للعمل بدوام كامل في فرعها بمدينة الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تعزيز المبيعات وتقديم تجربة مميزة للعملاء، والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات استقبال العملاء وتقديم شرح مفصل حول المنتجات والخدمات المتوفرة. بيع المنتجات الصحية والمكملات الغذائية للعملاء. متابعة العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين لضمان تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. ترتيب المنتجات داخل الفرع والمحافظة على نظافة وتنظيم مساحة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع العملاء وتقديم معلومات واضحة. الالتزام بتحقيق الأهداف المحددة والمساهمة في نمو المبيعات. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في فرع الشركة بمدينة الرياض. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة وتقديم أفضل خدمة للعملاء في مجال اللياقة البدنية والصحة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة للانضمام إلى فريق green fitness.

c0df81d58db1b1dc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التشييد الشرقي للمقاولات عن كاتب شكاوى للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة البلاغات الواردة من المستفيدين، بدءًا من التسجيل وحتى الإغلاق، مع ضمان الدقة والالتزام بالجودة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مناسبة للمبتدئين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال البلاغات الواردة من المستفيدين وتسجيلها بدقة في الأنظمة المعتمدة. التحقق من صحة واكتمال جميع البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بالبلاغ. تصنيف البلاغات حسب نوعها وأولويتها لتسهيل عملية المعالجة. توجيه البلاغات إلى الجهات أو الأقسام المختصة لمتابعتها. متابعة حالة البلاغات بشكل مستمر والتأكد من معالجتها وإغلاقها في الوقت المناسب. تحديث بيانات البلاغات بشكل مستمر لضمان دقة المعلومات. الرد على استفسارات المستفيدين المتعلقة بالبلاغات المقدمة. إعداد التقارير الدورية عن أعداد البلاغات ومعدلات الإنجاز. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على استخدام الأنظمة المعتمدة لتسجيل وتتبع البلاغات. مهارات جيدة في التواصل لخدمة المستفيدين والرد على استفساراتهم. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل عند تسجيل البيانات. الالتزام بسرعة الاستجابة وجودة الخدمة المقدمة. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة وتصنيف البلاغات بفعالية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة التشييد الشرقي للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

c02d07626d939bc5.description: About stc stc is a leading telecommunications company based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. We are currently seeking a Senior Warehouse Officer to join our team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Senior Warehouse Officer is responsible for managing logistics operations across all warehouses in the Southern and Western districts. This includes overseeing receiving, inspection, storage, auction processes, and the outflow of goods to ensure timely material availability for daily business operations. The role also involves implementing programs to maintain a safe and healthy warehousing environment, in adherence to stipulated business policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Ensure logistics activities in the Southern and Western districts comply with operational and documentation controls. Implement programs to assure a safe and healthy work environment and compliance with regulatory requirements in warehousing, in coordination with the S&S team. Process warehousing transactions promptly to serve customers in the Southern and Western districts. Manage and perform warehouse transactions including receiving, inspecting, storing, and issuing stock items. Coordinate with Finance regarding physical inventory and cycle count activities. Maintain and optimize warehousing facilities and space. Ensure good housekeeping across all warehousing facilities. Participate in the auction process. Conduct and organize monthly safety audits at each location. Ensure prompt processing and handling of overages, shortages, damages, and rejected materials in accordance with established procedures. Manage packing and preparation of material for shipping. Provide support for the delivery of auctions, temporary storage, shipping, mail, and document archiving services. Archive and organize live and final accounts records. Manage risks associated with warehouse operations, including information confidentiality, safety and security, and inventory damage. Monitoring and Control Monitor vendor compliance with Supply Chain regulations and standards. Track stock footprint, including levels and locations. Conduct periodic audits for stock keeping points. Promote, implement, and ensure compliance with sustainability requirements. Lead all operations covering the acquisition, storage, scrap processing, movement, and disposal of materials. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in warehouse management or logistics operations. Demonstrated ability to manage logistics activities and ensure operational compliance. Experience in implementing safety and health programs within a warehousing environment. Work Environment This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing operations across Southern and Western districts.

c05166bea4120cb0.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Product Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing, configuring, maintaining, and supporting the organization's business applications to ensure they are reliable, efficient, and achieve their intended benefits. Key Responsibilities Implement, configure, maintain, support, monitor, and enhance business applications, including HR/FIN/SCM, service management, project management, content/document management, and collaboration platforms. Provide training and guidance to end-users on the effective use and management of business applications. Maintain and manage ERP systems across Fakeeh Care business units. Support multiple projects and tasks within the assigned ERP portfolio and related business applications. Ensure business applications comply with best practices, regulatory requirements, enterprise architecture standards, governance programs, and cybersecurity policies. Manage engagements with contracted vendors for business application support, managed services, or professional services. Investigate and resolve business application-related incidents and fulfill service requests in compliance with organizational policies. Evaluate and process IT demand requests involving business applications, supporting approved requests according to the IT project management framework. Develop new system and application implementation plans, custom scripts, and testing procedures. Continuously monitor the performance and availability of systems and networks. Plan, test, and implement upgrades for information systems and integrate new software applications into existing systems. Oversee and supervise system administrators, coordinating with different entities for seamless operations. Ensure efficient integration and deployment of new applications across the business. Maintain up-to-date technical documentation, ensuring it is organized and accessible. Develop and implement backup and disaster recovery procedures, as well as security procedures to protect systems. Develop tools, procedures, and training sessions for Operations, Client Support, and Systems Development staff. Install, configure, and maintain servers and data storage systems. Mentor and guide junior colleagues and educate users on system administration best practices. Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices in system administration. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong knowledge of system administration for complex operating systems. At least five full-cycle implementation projects within ERP systems. Proficiency in designing, implementing, and maintaining mission-critical systems. Expertise in monitoring system performance and availability. Required Skills Strong problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges. Excellent documentation and organizational skills for maintaining technical records. Leadership and mentoring skills to guide team members and educate users. Knowledge of emerging technologies and best practices in system administration. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Fakeeh Care Group. c05a24bd5d1add1e.description: About the Role Egis (KSA) is seeking a Senior Contracts professional to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This permanent role involves overseeing all aspects of contract management, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations, and contributing to organizational success. Key Responsibilities Develop, negotiate, and manage complex contracts, ensuring full compliance with Saudi Arabian regulations and international standards. Oversee the complete contract lifecycle, from initiation through closeout, for multiple stakeholders, vendors, and internal departments. Establish and maintain robust contract management systems and processes to enhance efficiency and transparency. Identify, analyze, and proactively mitigate contractual risks, resolving disputes and claims in a timely and professional manner. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including procurement, finance, operations, and legal to ensure alignment with organizational objectives. Prepare comprehensive financial analyses, forecasts, and budget reports related to contract performance and expenditures. Provide regular, detailed status updates and strategic reports to senior management and key stakeholders. Stay current with evolving local construction codes, Saudi Arabian business regulations, and international best practices in contract management. Lead and mentor junior contract management staff, fostering continuous improvement and professional development. Customize contract templates and documentation to reflect organizational standards while maintaining legal compliance. Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in contract management for large-scale projects or organizational operations. Extensive knowledge of international contract law, FIDIC contracts, and Saudi Arabian commercial regulations. Proven track record of successfully managing complex, high-value contracts and resolving contractual disputes. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and contract management software platforms. Required Skills Exceptional negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. Strong leadership capabilities with demonstrated experience managing and developing teams in multicultural environments. Demonstrated expertise in financial analysis, budget management, and cost forecasting. Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. Knowledge of risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies in contractual contexts. Willingness to work collaboratively across departments and adapt to evolving business needs. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the construction, infrastructure, or project management sectors. Familiarity with contract management systems and digital documentation platforms. c01adb8022a88b81.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في سكاكا، الجوف. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على تركيب وصيانة وتشخيص الأعطال في الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج تركيب الأجهزة الطبية، مثل أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية بكفاءة. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إجراء الفحوصات الضرورية للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة بعد الصيانة أو الإصلاح. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على إعداد خطط التركيب وبرامج التشغيل للأجهزة الطبية. مهارات عالية في تشخيص الأعطال وإجراءات الصيانة. القدرة على إعداد وتطبيق برامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في سكاكا، الجوف، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على الجودة والكفاءة في إدارة وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين الذين تتوافق خبراتهم مع متطلبات هذا الدور للتقديم.

c05b35db62ce9a2c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الجوف الأهلية عن معلم للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في سكاكا، الجوف. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد، وتقديم الدعم لتنميتهم الأكاديمية والشخصية. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل للمعلمين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة أو الخبرة التي تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص، مع التركيز على تقديم تعليم فعال ومحفز. وضع خطط الدروس التي تتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. تقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية للطلاب، مع مراعاة الاحتياجات التعليمية المتنوعة. دعم التنمية الشاملة للطلاب، بما في ذلك الجوانب الأكاديمية والاجتماعية. المهام اليومية تطوير خطط الدروس التي تتماشى مع موضوع المنهج الدراسي والأهداف الأكاديمية للمدرسة. اختيار المصادر التعليمية المناسبة لدعم عملية التعلم. تصميم المواد التعليمية، والدروس، وطرق التدريس، والمحتوى التعليمي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التدريس. القدرة على تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم لإنشاء خطط الدروس والمواد التعليمية. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مدارس الجوف الأهلية في سكاكا، الجوف. يلتزم فريق العمل بتقديم تعليم عالي الجودة ودعم مستمر لتنمية الطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. هذه فرصة للمساهمة في بيئة تعليمية ديناميكية والمساعدة في تشكيل مستقبل الطلاب.

c0bea1d1c64436a3.description: About Albawani Albawani, established in 1991 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a leading construction and contracting company in the Kingdom. c0bfa76c84bce6f7.description: About the Role Magrabi Health is seeking a Heating Air Conditioning Technician to join their team in Jazan, Saudi Arabia. c077d9683f83df7b.description: نبحث عن باريستا موهوب ومتحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تقديم تجربة قهوة استثنائية لعملائنا. ستقوم بإعداد مجموعة متنوعة من مشروبات القهوة والاسبريسو بجودة عالية، مع التركيز على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. إذا كنت شغوفًا بالقهوة ولديك مهارات تواصل جيدة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. مهام ومسؤوليات الوظيفة: * إعداد وتقديم مشروبات القهوة والاسبريسو المتنوعة بدقة واحترافية. * التعامل مع العملاء بلطف وود، وتقديم توصيات بناءً على تفضيلاتهم. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل ومعدات القهوة. * إدارة المخزون وطلب المواد اللازمة للحفاظ على سير العمل بسلاسة. شباب وبنات خبرة عمل عقد لسعودين والتسجيل فى التامينات الغير سعودى عقد أجير فقط

c09625f524f731d6.company_name: مجمع نزار ابراهيم غلام لطب وتقويم الاسنان الطبي المتخصص
c09625f524f731d6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب مساعدة طبيب الأسنان في المهام اليومية للعيادة، بما في ذلك تحضير المواد والأدوات، وضمان بيئة عمل معقمة ومنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي طب الأسنان، مع توثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في الملفات المخصصة. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان بشكل دوري، بالإضافة إلى تفقد وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة للأسنان، وكذلك خلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء إجراءات العلاج، وتزويده بالأدوات والمواد حسب طلبه، وسحب اللعاب. تفقد أدوات ومعدات العمل وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مساعد طبيب الأسنان. القدرة على تحضير المواد السنية وخلط الحشوات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع الأدوات والمعدات الطبية. بيئة العمل سيعمل مساعد طبيب الأسنان ضمن فريق عيادة الأسنان في حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وكفاءة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في مجال طب الأسنان. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c0deebb4f5c73371.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في مدينة الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه، وإجراء دراسة شاملة للحالة المرضية. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية بشكل دوري. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي ذي الصلة. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق طبي متخصص في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان في الخرج، الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور متاح في مدينة الخرج، الرياض، ويوفر فرصة للانضمام إلى مؤسسة طبية رائدة في مجال طب الأسنان. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

c04ae5adb5b889fe.description: About the Role CHINT is seeking a Supply Chain Manager to oversee procurement, sourcing, material planning, inventory, and logistics. This full-time role is based in Dammam, Eastern Province, and is critical for ensuring the timely and cost-effective availability of materials for our MV manufacturing operations within the Dammam MV Joint Venture setup with ATC. Key Responsibilities Develop procurement and material supply plans that align with production schedules, project requirements, and sales forecasts. Identify, evaluate, and develop qualified suppliers both locally and internationally, expanding sourcing options beyond the Saudi market. Source MV products, raw materials, and accessories in coordination with Engineering and QA/QC to ensure compliance with technical specifications and customer requirements. Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and supply agreements to improve costs and supply reliability. Monitor supplier performance, manage shortages, and develop alternative sources for critical materials. Establish appropriate minimum and maximum stock levels, improve inventory accuracy, and reduce excess and slow-moving stock. Coordinate international shipments, customs clearance, and delivery to the factory. Ensure purchasing approvals, supplier evaluations, and material transactions comply with company procedures and are accurately recorded in SAP/ERP. Support localization and supplier development initiatives. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in supply chain management. Demonstrated experience in procurement, sourcing, material planning, inventory management, and logistics. Proficiency in SAP/ERP systems for recording material transactions and managing supply chain processes. Work Environment This role is a full-time position based in Dammam, within CHINT's MV Joint Venture setup with ATC. What CHINT Offers A competitive salary and benefits package. Support for work-life balance. Opportunities for professional development.

c068506d31893165.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الشريف للمقاولات والتنمية التجارية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتنفيذ ومتابعة المشاريع الكهربائية لمحطات التحويل والتوليد، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد التقارير الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع محطات التحويل والتوليد. متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال الميدانية لضمان الالتزام بالمواصفات والمعايير. تحديد مسارات ومتطلبات التشغيل لأنظمة وخطوط محطات التوليد وشبكات ومحطات التحويل الكهربائية. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية ضمن المشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية داخل المحطات. متابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والمعالجة مع الجهات المعنية لضمان استمرارية العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الفنية المتخصصة بناءً على نتائج الدراسات والتحاليل. عرض ومناقشة الوثائق والتقارير لتحسين كفاءة وموثوقية أنظمة محطات التوليد والتحويل الكهربائية. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الكهربائي وأنظمة محطات الطاقة. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الفنية بدقة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص الأعطال وتقديم الحلول. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية وعرضها بوضوح. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع الفرق الداخلية والجهات الخارجية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي في هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع محطات التحويل والتوليد. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة الشريف للمقاولات والتنمية التجارية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c0859da34dc00d30.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة وسياسات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تقديم حلول متكاملة في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c09c111fa58c1d0b.job_title: Digital Marketing and Communications Assistant (Outsourced) ICD
c09c111fa58c1d0b.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Digital Marketing and Communications Assistant (Outsourced) to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This contract position requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on the management, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organization's digital presence. Role Overview This role is responsible for overseeing the management, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of corporate websites, digital platforms, and social media channels. The Digital Marketing and Communications Assistant ensures the reliability, efficiency, and effectiveness of digital services while driving digital transformation, automation, and technological enhancements. The position also involves managing technical vendors, digital projects, system subscriptions, and performance reporting to ensure operational continuity and compliance with organizational standards. Additionally, the role provides administrative and technical support for events, stakeholder coordination, CRM management, digital documentation, and multimedia libraries to support the effective delivery of organizational objectives. Key Accountabilities Manage, maintain, and continuously improve corporate websites and digital platforms, including CMS operations, SEO, technical upgrades, and integrations. Ensure websites and applications meet security, accessibility, usability, and performance standards. Oversee domain registrations, renewals, DNS configurations, SSL certificates, and hosting services, coordinating server administration, website deployments, backups, and disaster recovery. Administer and secure corporate social media accounts, managing user access, platform configurations, and integrations. Identify opportunities for digital platform modernization, evaluating AI-powered tools, automation, chatbots, and system integrations to improve operational efficiency and user experience. Manage external website development agencies, hosting providers, and technical vendors, defining technical requirements, project scope, and monitoring performance. Establish standards for website administration, security, access control, and operational documentation, overseeing website analytics and digital performance reporting. Monitor and track renewal timelines for all relevant system subscriptions, licenses, and service contracts. Provide logistical support for IsDB Group events and meetings, facilitating communication with internal and external stakeholders. Maintain and update a centralized database and CRM, and organize multimedia libraries for events and initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in digital marketing and communications, with a focus on digital platform management and technical support. A strong understanding of website management, social media administration, digital transformation initiatives, and vendor management is essential. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Group, providing support across various digital initiatives and collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

c01a17938b0a454e.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking a Mortuary Technician to join their team in Al-Ahsa. This is a full-time technical position responsible for the dignified, safe, and hygienic operation of the hospital mortuary. The role requires strict adherence to Ministry of Health (MOH) infection control protocols and maintaining the physical chain of custody for deceased patients. Role Purpose and Context The Mortuary Technician ensures the mortuary facility operates in compliance with all relevant health and safety standards. This includes managing environmental safety within the cold storage facility and coordinating with various departments and external authorities to facilitate proper procedures for deceased individuals. The position is critical for upholding ethical standards and regulatory requirements in patient care post-mortem. Key Responsibilities Receive bodies from clinical wards, ensuring verification of "Dual Identifier" tags and meticulous documentation of the chain of custody in the Morgue Register. Monitor and accurately record temperature and humidity levels of cold chambers in accordance with established policies and procedures, reporting any deviations immediately. Coordinate and oversee terminal cleaning and disinfection of storage units, hydraulic lifts, and all surfaces using hospital-grade agents to maintain hygiene standards. Apply specific MOH precautions, including shrouding and bagging, for bodies identified as High-Risk Infectious (*, COVID-19, MERS). Provide assistance to forensic authorities with body identification and sample preservation in cases requiring police involvement. Physically release bodies to authorized family members or municipality services, ensuring all necessary documentation is completed. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to adhere strictly to infection control protocols and safety standards. Proficiency in documentation and record-keeping. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Al-Ahsa and involves working within a hospital mortuary setting. The role requires a commitment to maintaining a safe and hygienic environment, often under sensitive circumstances, and collaborating with clinical and forensic teams. Application Information Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare.

c01abb6d490c29cc.description: About the Role Wataniya Insurance Co. is seeking a Business Development Officer to manage and execute tasks related to tenders and bids, primarily through the Etimad platform and similar e-procurement systems. This full-time role involves ensuring compliance with government sector requirements, overseeing the framework agreement for government vehicle insurance via the e-market, and providing direct support to clients to achieve satisfaction and sales targets. Key Responsibilities Monitor and review tender documents, requirements, and terms of reference on Etimad and other relevant platforms. Coordinate the preparation and submission of technical and financial proposals with internal departments within deadlines. Manage all official correspondence, clarifications, and follow-ups related to bid status. Oversee requests and bidding opportunities for the government vehicle insurance framework agreement via the e-market. Ensure accurate preparation and submission of offers, follow up on purchase orders, and coordinate policy issuance. Monitor and follow up on due payments for timely collection and liaise with government entities to resolve issues. Receive and present insurance products to direct clients (individuals and corporates), prepare quotations, and explain policy coverage. Follow up on client requests, provide renewal support, and handle complaints in coordination with relevant departments. Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and loyalty. Administrative Duties Coordinate with the sales department to maintain and update the database of tenders and clients. Prepare monthly performance reports detailing the number of tenders, business volume, new clients, win rates, and client satisfaction. Contribute to the improvement of bidding and sales strategies based on past experiences and outcomes. Ensure full compliance with the regulations set by the Insurance Authority (IA) and other relevant regulatory bodies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in business development, tender management, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage e-procurement platforms such as Etimad. Experience in client relationship management and direct sales. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail for proposal preparation and compliance. Reporting and Compliance The Business Development Officer will be responsible for providing periodic reports to management on submitted tenders, outcomes, win rates, business volume under framework agreements, and direct sales performance. Adherence to all regulatory requirements and internal policies is essential for this role. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c07553e4d0804227.description: Job Summary IA Group is seeking a dedicated and experienced Sales Manager to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires a professional with a strong background in sales management, focused on achieving targets and optimizing sales performance. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Prepare and monitor sales targets, forecasts, and sales plans. Develop and review periodic sales lists and reports, and analyze sales performance. Manage customer relationships and oversee key and new accounts. Monitor costs and expenses, and analyze deviations from the sales budget. Develop sales controls and procedures, and enhance internal oversight of the sales team. Supervise deal closing processes, sales settlements, and collections. Ensure compliance with Saudi market regulations and standards, as well as internal policies. Prepare sales indicators and reports to support management in decision-making. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3-7 years of experience in sales management. Proven ability to develop and execute sales strategies. Strong analytical skills for sales performance and budget analysis. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh. The Sales Manager will work within a dynamic team, contributing to the company's growth and market presence. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c08624fc06a594e4.company_name: مجمع عيادات التبيان التخصصية لطب الاسنان
c08624fc06a594e4.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يبحث مجمع الجريبي الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في جازان. يتمحور هذا الدور حول تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التركيبات السنية ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان بدقة. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع كل حالة مرضية. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية. أخذ القياسات اللازمة للتعويضات السنية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. إتقان إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع الجريبي الطبي بمدينة جازان. يعمل طبيب الأسنان ضمن فريق طبي متخصص، ملتزماً بتطبيق أعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة في تقديم الرعاية الصحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

c0b9c62308423e92.job_title: PDI Technician Al Futtaim Automotive BYD
c0b9c62308423e92.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking an EV Charging Technical Lead to manage its EV charging infrastructure, encompassing both home and flash charging solutions, across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves hands-on site execution, contractor oversight, and technical reporting to ensure all chargers within the Charge2Moov network are installed, commissioned, and maintained according to OEM and regulatory standards. The position requires 3-6 years of experience. Role Context and Accountability Reporting to the Senior Manager – EV Charging, the Technical Lead serves as the primary technical point of contact between field contractors, internal commercial and aftersales teams, and KSA regulatory bodies such as SE, SASO, and MOMRAH. This role is central to maintaining network uptime, ensuring customer satisfaction, and supporting the strategic expansion of Al-Futtaim's EV charging ecosystem, which is a key component of the brand's EV proposition in KSA. Key Duties Investigate and resolve customer complaints related to AC home chargers and DC public chargers across assigned sites within the Kingdom. Perform on-site diagnostics, fault rectification, and corrective maintenance to restore charger uptime within defined SLA windows. Execute software upgrades, firmware patches, and configuration management activities on AC charger hardware. Conduct Level-1 maintenance and structured fault diagnosis on DC fast-chargers in accordance with OEM guidelines. Support the commissioning and functional testing of newly installed chargers, providing technical sign-off only after full verification against acceptance criteria. Perform detailed site surveys and technical readiness assessments prior to DC charger installations. c08d2e71f17aa752.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة ابتكارات الشرق للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير كميات المواد، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال وتشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل تتمركز الوظيفة في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة ابتكارات الشرق للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c0d6af6cb3735ea2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة النعيم للخرسانة الجاهزة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة المبرز. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وترويج المنتجات، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة. إعداد وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في شركة النعيم للخرسانة الجاهزة، وتتطلب العمل في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينة المبرز. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

c008661eda1acc92.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الاسنان عن فني تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الرعاية التمريضية والشخصية الأساسية للمرضى، والعمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية آخر. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للممرضين وأخصائيي الرعاية الصحية الآخرين في تخطيط وإدارة رعاية المرضى. المساعدة في إعطاء الأدوية الموصوفة والإحالة إلى أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية عند الحاجة. مساعدة المرضى في أمور النظافة الشخصية والأنشطة الأساسية مثل الاغتسال والحلاقة. المساعدة في الأنشطة اليومية مثل تناول الطعام والتمرينات، وتقديم الوجبات والمشروبات حسب خطط الرعاية. مساعدة المرضى في التنقل والالتفاف وتغيير الوضع، بالإضافة إلى مساعدتهم في دخول دورات المياه وأثناء الاستحمام. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض أو الرعاية الصحية. القدرة على العمل تحت إشراف مباشر من ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التعامل مع المرضى بلطف واحترافية. القدرة على تقديم الرعاية الأساسية والدعم الشخصي للمرضى. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة في بيئة الرعاية الصحية. التطوير المهني الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر. دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة والمشاركة في الدورات التدريبية والمؤتمرات ذات الصلة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة في مجمع عيادات تبوك الورد لطب الاسنان.

c02f5336e5494ae4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، مع إمكانية العمل في الخرج. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيساهم المهندس المدني في الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية وضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الجوانب الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية للموقع الإنشائي، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبارات فحص التربة. مراجعة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي شامل لعناصره المختلفة. إعداد تصاميم المشروع، ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقته للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل البيانات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية. مهارات قوية في إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية وتدقيق المخططات وجداول الكميات. القدرة على الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة مجموعة المجال العربي، في بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح له تطبيق خبراته في مشاريع متنوعة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الرياض، مع إمكانية العمل في الخرج حسب متطلبات المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. هذه فرصة للمهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة والمساهمة في تنفيذ مشاريع إنشائية مهمة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة مجموعة المجال العربي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c0bffd07c9b3b284.description: About the Role Yusuf Bin Ahmed Kanoo Group Of Companies - Saudi Arabia is seeking a Sales Manager - Kanoo Logistics to lead sales and commercial activities for the Logistics Division in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on driving revenue generation and business growth within the region. Key Responsibilities Organize and lead area sales efforts to achieve all sales targets and ensure the sales team meets required standards. Conduct direct sales efforts with new and existing customers as needed. Develop and implement procedures to ensure the sales force operates efficiently and effectively, achieving all sales objectives. Monitor sales staff performance and take corrective action to ensure sales targets are met. Monitor and control the area budget to meet financial targets and comply with company and regulatory financial controls. Develop and maintain relationships with key customers and relevant bodies to maximize the division’s sales potential. Stay informed of developments in sales techniques and technology to maintain and enhance the division’s competitive position. Monitor competitors' sales performance to ensure the division maintains and develops its competitive position. Research new sales opportunities within the existing account portfolio and identify new potential Key Accounts in the region. Monitor customer feedback to assess satisfaction with company products. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in sales leadership within the logistics sector. The role requires a proven ability to drive revenue and manage sales teams effectively. Reporting and Objectives The Sales Manager will report directly to leadership within the Logistics Division and will be responsible for achieving defined sales targets and business growth objectives. Success in this role is measured by the ability to expand market share and enhance customer relationships. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves leading regional sales efforts and requires a presence within the designated area. Application Process Further details regarding the salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply directly.

c0c9e21125739aab.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking a Control Room Operator to join their team in Al Qassim. This full-time position involves monitoring and controlling plant operating parameters and coordinating with other operators to ensure smooth plant operations. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Comply with all safety rules and regulations and maintain familiarity with firefighting equipment in the assigned area. Understand plant P&IDs, SOPs, work instructions, operation and control logic, and emergency operating procedures. Monitor unit parameters, record periodic readings, and summarize shift activities and events in the logbook. Follow instructions from the Shift Charge Engineer and Shift Supervisor, coordinating operational activities with other operators. Respond promptly and effectively to abnormal operating conditions. Coordinate and ensure proper Lock Out & Tag Out (LOTO) procedures during equipment isolation for maintenance, in accordance with approved Permit to Work (PTW) procedures. Normalize equipment as instructed after cancellation. Inspect the unit and auxiliaries during shifts to ensure all equipment parameters are within acceptable limits, reporting any abnormalities to the Shift Supervisor or Shift Charge Engineer. Perform periodic protection tests under supervision and maintain required records. Execute equipment changeovers according to established schedules. Raise work requests or defect notifications for faulty equipment and follow up on rectification. Assist in the training and familiarization of new operators. Report near misses and implement prescribed risk controls. Report deviations related to the Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental Management System. Ensure proper waste disposal measures are followed. Perform other assigned duties as required. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a control room or plant operations role. Demonstrated understanding of plant operations, safety protocols, and emergency procedures. Ability to monitor complex systems and respond effectively to operational changes. Work Environment This role requires readiness to work in a remote location within Al Qassim. The position is full-time, and salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

If you are a dynamic self-starter looking for a progressive career opportunity then this could be the perfect role for you and the first step of your career with a leader in prestige beauty. While certification in make up artistry and/or previous retail make up experience is desirable we also welcome applicants with amateur level experience. As a leader in prestige beauty with a culture that values diversity of thought and people, we offer excellent training and development and a competitive remuneration and benefits package. Qualifications While a qualification in make-up artistry/previous retail make up experience is preferred, we welcome applicants with amateur level experience who are able to demonstrate a high level of creative and technical expertise All applicants must be able to demonstrate the ability to provide inspirational, authentic and personalized customer service Ability to work retail hours including days, nights, weekends and special events in a fast-paced work environment Previous experience with retail point-of-sale software Applicants must be able to provide proof of right to live and work in the country if invited to attend for interview
